description: Land Title Settlement Department - Atorawa, Mailawe, Nallachchiya, Radagamu etc. Thambuttegama D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - Cad. Map No. 220053
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and declarations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed information about specific land parcels (numbers, locations, extents, ownership details) and the Commissioner's determination regarding land titles. The content focuses entirely on land and property matters, specifically title settlement and registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
